Status note: GitHub tests/build/scan passed; the optional Actions → AWS deploy job was skipped. Argo CD sync was verified separately.

Explain both planes. Runtime: the browser reaches a Traefik load balancer; Ingress routes root traffic to React and /api to FastAPI. FastAPI uses PostgreSQL with durable gp3 storage. A release migration Job runs Alembic before normal application operation. Delivery: GitHub Actions verifies and publishes SHA-tagged images to GHCR; Argo CD watches the repository Helm definition and reconciles the AWS EKS application. Prometheus and Grafana provide monitoring. The screenshot evidence shows successful CI and separately verified healthy Argo CD; the optional GitHub Actions AWS deployment job was skipped, so do not describe that job as successful.

alt: GitHub Actions run showing passed test and image build scan publish jobs; AWS deployment skipped

text:
The supplied Actions screenshot is a successful workflow: test and build-scan-publish completed successfully. The deploy-aws job is visibly skipped. Therefore present GitHub-hosted CI/image publishing as verified and AWS deployment as separately performed and verified with Argo CD. SHA-tagged images make a release traceable to a source commit.

alt: Terminal showing AWS Kubernetes pods, services, ingress, HPA, PVC and completed migration Job

text:
The terminal capture shows the AWS deployment state after sync: two backend replicas and two frontend replicas are Running, PostgreSQL is Running, the migration Job completed, the gp3 PVC is Bound, and the backend HPA has minimum two, maximum six, with two replicas at roughly 3% CPU against the 60% target. This is healthy deployment evidence, not proof that autoscaling exceeded its minimum.

Evidence/source files: docs/screenshots/image(1).png, docs/screenshots/kubectlgetnodesterraform.png

text:
This Grafana capture shows request-rate activity peaking around 30 requests/second, p95 latency around 14 ms at the visible peak, no visible 5xx errors, and a CPU response during generated traffic. The Prometheus capture shows targets marked UP on the visible page; it does not clearly expose the StockPilot service target in the screenshot, so describe it as Prometheus target-health evidence rather than claiming a specific target row. HPA remained at two replicas as shown earlier.

Close with the verified story and state its boundaries accurately. CI checks and image publication passed. The GitOps application was Synced and Healthy in AWS. Kubernetes workloads and monitoring were verified. The separate deploy-aws GitHub Actions job was skipped in the screenshot. Since the AWS environment was intended to exist only for evidence capture, destroy the stack after the presentation/video and check that billable resources are removed.
